2026_04_NE_BUF.headline: Buffalo’s front gets a wounded Patriots line with Drake Maye searching for answers
2026_04_NE_BUF.paragraph1: Buffalo’s defense gets a favorable pressure setup against a New England line that has lost guard Greg Van Roten to injured reserve. Bills coordinator Jim Leonhard is preparing for Drake Maye after a difficult opening stretch in which sacks and interceptions have disrupted the Patriots’ offense. On the other side, James Cook is coming off a major rushing performance for unbeaten Buffalo. New England must protect Maye and control early downs; Buffalo can dictate the game if its front repeatedly creates long-yardage situations.
2026_04_NE_BUF.model_rationale: Buffalo’s ability to pressure a compromised New England protection unit and stay efficient on the ground gives the Bills multiple paths to control down, distance and possession quality.
